description: This file defines the DelegatorContainer class which implements the Container interface for managing delegators in the OFBiz framework. It handles initialization, starting preloaded delegators asynchronously, and providing container metadata.

classes.name: DelegatorContainer
classes.description: A container class responsible for managing delegators within the OFBiz framework, including initialization and asynchronous startup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with commands, name, and configuration file. Loads the list of preloaded delegator names from configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts preloaded delegators asynchronously using futures and executes their startup via the execution pool.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container.
